items.text: The European Court of Auditors makes sure EU funds are correctly accounted for, and all funds are raised and spent in line with EU financial rules.

items.title: European Union Agency for Asylum (EUAA)
items.text: The European Union Agency for Asylum provides operational and technical support to EU countries to help them implement EU law on asylum effectively.

items.title: European Public Prosecutor’s Office (EPPO)
items.text: An independent body of the EU, the European Public Prosecutor’s Office (EPPO) investigates, prosecutes and brings to judgment crimes against the financial interests of the EU.

items.text: The Smart Networks and Services Joint Undertaking fosters alignment with EU countries for 6G research and innovation, and boosts 5G deployment in Europe.

items.title: Single Resolution Board (SRB)
items.text: The Single Resolution Board creates standard rules, procedures and practical arrangements for bank resolutions in the EU.

items.text: The Innovative Health Initiative Joint Undertaking is turning health research and innovation into real benefits for patients and society and making Europe’s health industries globally competitive.

items.text: Frontex helps EU countries to manage their external borders and harmonise their border controls by providing technical support and expertise.
